section: DRDO - vision, mission, structure, major laboratories and technology clusters
subsections: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: DRDL, a DRDO laboratory located in Hyderabad, is correctly expanded as:
accepted.x: DRDL stands for Defence Research and Development Laboratory. It is located in Hyderabad and is associated with missile development.
accepted.tq: Test the exact official expansion rather than a look-alike phrase.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: Research Centre Imarat, commonly abbreviated as RCI, is located at:
accepted.x: Research Centre Imarat is a DRDO laboratory located in Hyderabad. It works mainly on missile guidance and avionics.
accepted.tq: Use the location clue to distinguish Hyderabad’s missile laboratories.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the principal field of the Advanced Systems Laboratory (ASL), Hyderabad?
o: Ballistic missiles, including the Agni series
accepted.x: ASL is associated with long-range and ballistic missiles, particularly the Agni series.
accepted.tq: Match the laboratory with its specialised technological field.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Defence Metallurgical Research Laboratory (DMRL):
1. It is located in Hyderabad.
2. It works on metals, alloys and armour materials.
3. It has developed Sm-Co and Nd-Fe-B magnets.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. DMRL, Hyderabad conducts research on metals and materials, including specialised magnets and armour-related materials.
accepted.tq: Check whether the location, field and examples all belong to the same laboratory.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: The tungsten heavy-alloy penetrator rods mentioned in connection with DMRL belong to which broad area of research?
accepted.x: DMRL’s work includes metals, alloys and armour materials, including tungsten heavy-alloy penetrator rods.
accepted.tq: Infer the laboratory from the material-science application.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: Which DRDO laboratory is primarily associated with electronic warfare?
accepted.x: The Defence Electronics Research Laboratory (DLRL) at Hyderabad is associated with electronic warfare.
accepted.tq: Identify the laboratory from its specialised defence function.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s:
Which of the following is correctly matched?
1. DFRL — Meals Ready to Eat for the armed forces
2. ARDE — Guns, ammunition and warheads
3. NSTL — Torpedoes, mines and autonomous underwater vehicles
4. CAIR — Artificial intelligence and robotics
accepted.x: All four matches are correct. DFRL, ARDE, NSTL and CAIR respectively cover food technology, armaments, naval weapons and AI/robotics.
accepted.tq: Verify each laboratory against its distinctive specialisation.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: Armament Research and Development Establishment (ARDE), which designed Pinaka, is located at:
accepted.x: ARDE is located in Pune and works on guns, ammunition and warheads. It designed the Pinaka system.
accepted.tq: Link a named defence system with its laboratory and location.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: Which laboratory is described as a partner of ARDE in work related to Pinaka and specialises in propellants and explosives?
accepted.x: The High Energy Materials Research Laboratory (HEMRL), Pune works on propellants and explosives and is a partner of ARDE on Pinaka.
accepted.tq: Use the partner relationship to identify the correct laboratory.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: The Naval Science and Technological Laboratory (NSTL) is situated at:
accepted.x: NSTL is located in Visakhapatnam and works on naval weapons such as torpedoes, mines and AUVs.
accepted.tq: Distinguish naval laboratories by their city and function.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: DEBEL — Bengaluru — Medical oxygen plant and underwater breathing apparatus
ADE — Bengaluru — UAVs and target drones
INMAS — Bengaluru — Nuclear medicine and CBRN protection
CAIR — Bengaluru — Artificial intelligence and robotics
accepted.x: INMAS is located in Delhi, not Bengaluru. It works on nuclear medicine and CBRN protection, whereas CAIR, DEBEL and ADE are Bengaluru laboratories.
accepted.tq: Find the location mismatch while retaining the correct specialisation.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: The Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics (CAIR) is mainly concerned with:
o: AI, robotics, unmanned systems and battlefield communication networks
Food preservation and meat test kits
accepted.x: CAIR, Bengaluru works on artificial intelligence, robotics, unmanned systems and battlefield communication networks.
accepted.tq: Select the option containing the laboratory’s complete functional cluster.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the correct expansion of DEBEL?
accepted.x: DEBEL stands for Defence Bioengineering and Electromedical Laboratory. It is located in Bengaluru.
accepted.tq: Discriminate among closely worded official expansions.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: Rustom/TAPAS BH-201, Nishant and Lakshya are associated with which DRDO laboratory?
o: Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics
accepted.x: The Aeronautical Development Establishment (ADE), Bengaluru works on UAVs such as Rustom/TAPAS BH-201, Nishant and the Lakshya target drone.
accepted.tq: Separate the DRDO laboratory ADE from the autonomous society ADA.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: TAPAS BH-201 is classified in the material as a:
accepted.x: TAPAS BH-201 is identified as a MALE unmanned aerial vehicle associated with ADE.
accepted.tq: Use the platform classification to identify the correct technology.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
1. LRDE — Radars
2. CVRDE — Arjun tank
3. VRDE — Vehicles
4. DEAL — Communication
accepted.x: All four pairs are correct: LRDE works on radars, CVRDE on the Arjun tank, VRDE on vehicles and DEAL on communication systems.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure laboratory–technology pairs and verify the remaining pairs.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: Which DRDO laboratory is associated with soldier physiology, especially high-altitude and cold conditions?
accepted.x: The Defence Institute of Physiology and Allied Sciences (DIPAS) is located in Delhi and studies soldier physiology, including high-altitude and cold conditions.
accepted.tq: Distinguish similarly abbreviated institutions by their exact field and location.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s:
Which one of the following is correctly matched with its location and principal field?
1. NPOL — Kochi — Sonars
2. NMRL — Naval materials, fuel-cell Air Independent Propulsion
3. DIPR — Psychology
4. INMAS — Delhi — Nuclear medicine
accepted.x: All four associations are correct. NPOL is at Kochi, NMRL works on naval materials and fuel-cell AIP, DIPR works on psychology, and INMAS is in Delhi.
accepted.tq: Check both the institutional function and the location before choosing the code.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: Which laboratory is associated with missile guidance algorithms, IIR seekers, Ku-band RF seekers and navigation systems?
accepted.x: Research Centre Imarat (RCI), Hyderabad specialises in missile guidance and avionics, including IIR seekers, Ku-band RF seekers and navigation systems.
accepted.tq: Identify the laboratory from a cluster of closely related technologies.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the Hyderabad missile-laboratory cluster?
o: ARDE, HEMRL, NSTL, CAIR and ADE
LRDE, CVRDE, VRDE, DEAL and NPOL
DFRL, INMAS, DIPAS, DIPR and NMRL
DRDL, RCI, ASL, DMRL and DLRL
accepted.x: DRDL, RCI, ASL, DMRL and DLRL are all located in Hyderabad. They cover missile development, guidance, ballistic missiles, materials and electronic warfare.
accepted.tq: Use a group-location question to identify the complete cluster rather than one laboratory.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding DRDO laboratories:
1. ADA is an autonomous society under the Ministry of Defence.
2. ADA is itself a DRDO laboratory.
3. ADA designs the LCA Tejas with DRDO.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. ADA is an autonomous society under the Ministry of Defence that designs LCA Tejas with DRDO, but it is not itself a DRDO laboratory.
accepted.tq: Catch the classification trap between an autonomous society and a DRDO laboratory.
accepted.sec: DRDO laboratories - full form, location, field

accepted.s: The Jagadish Chandra Bose Centre for Advanced Technology is located at:
accepted.x: The centre was established at Jadavpur University in Kolkata with the help of DRDO.
accepted.tq: Match an academic centre with its host institution and city.
accepted.sec: DRDO-academia centres - host institution

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about DIA-CoEs is correct?
o: They are autonomous societies outside the Ministry of Defence with no academic participation.
They are five laboratories devoted exclusively to food research.
They are a network of 15 centres at premier institutions working on critical and futuristic defence technologies.
They are centres established only at naval bases for sonar development.
accepted.x: DIA-CoEs are a network of 15 DRDO Industry Academia Centres of Excellence at premier institutions such as IITs, IISc and central universities.
accepted.tq: Select the precise institutional description and reject narrowed scope claims.
accepted.sec: DRDO-academia centres - host institution

accepted.s: The principal institutional partners of DIA-CoEs include:
accepted.x: DIA-CoEs are established across premier institutions, including IITs, IISc and central universities.
accepted.tq: Test the composition of an institutional network.
accepted.sec: DRDO-academia centres - host institution

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding DRDO Young Scientist Laboratories established in 2020:
1. There are five such laboratories.
2. Their areas include artificial intelligence, quantum technology and cognitive technology.
3. Smart materials and asymmetric technology are also among their futuristic areas.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The five futuristic areas include AI, quantum, cognitive and asymmetric technologies, and smart materials.
accepted.tq: Combine the count with the complete list of specialised areas.
accepted.sec: DRDO-academia centres - host institution

accepted.s: In 2026, the DRDO Chairman referred to how many newly established laboratories and new DRDO centres working on underwater and space awareness, respectively?
accepted.x: The figures referred to were five newly established laboratories and fifteen new DRDO centres working on underwater and space awareness.
accepted.tq: Read the two numerical components in the correct order.
accepted.sec: DRDO-academia centres - host institution

accepted.s: Which institutional arrangement was advocated for improving defence technology deployment?
o: Academia should handle early-stage research and development, while laboratories, start-ups and MSMEs take products towards deployment.
Start-ups should undertake only basic research without laboratory support.
Only academia should manufacture and deploy all defence products.
DRDO laboratories should discontinue collaboration with start-ups and MSMEs.
accepted.x: The proposed division was for academia to undertake early-stage R&D, with laboratories, start-ups and MSMEs helping take products to deployment.
accepted.tq: Apply the stated division of roles across the innovation pipeline.
accepted.sec: DRDO-academia centres - host institution

accepted.s: Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT), Pune is best described as:
o: A central university under the Ministry of Education
accepted.x: DIAT, Pune is described as DRDO’s deemed university.
accepted.tq: Identify the institutional status rather than confusing it with a laboratory.
accepted.sec: DRDO-academia centres - host institution

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: DIA-CoEs — Premier academic institutions — Critical and futuristic defence technologies
DRDO Young Scientist Laboratories — 15 laboratories — Five futuristic areas
accepted.x: DRDO Young Scientist Laboratories comprise five laboratories, not fifteen. The figure of fifteen refers to the DIA-CoEs and, in another context, new DRDO centres.
accepted.tq: Separate the similar numerical facts associated with different DRDO initiatives.
accepted.sec: DRDO-academia centres - host institution

accepted.s:
Arrange the following DRDO-academia initiatives in chronological order of their establishment or reference:
A. DRDO Young Scientist Laboratories
B. JCBCAT at Jadavpur University
C. Reference to five newly established laboratories and fifteen new DRDO centres in 2026
D. DIA-CoEs network of 15 centres
accepted.x: JCBCAT was referenced in 2018, the Young Scientist Laboratories were established in 2020, the DIA-CoEs network is identified as a 15-centre network, and the five laboratories and fifteen centres were referred to in 2026.
accepted.tq: Fix the known dated milestones first, then place the institutional network before the 2026 reference.
accepted.sec: DRDO-academia centres - host institution
